rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese word for lightning, including both the visible flash and the electrical discharge.

example.english: There will be thunder and lightning tonight, so remember to close the windows properly.
example.traditional: 今晚行雷閃電，記住閂好啲窗。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 haang4 leoi4 sim2 din6 gei3 zyu6 saan1 hou2 di1 coeng1

rows.note: A speaker uses this mainly in written or literary descriptions of the visible flash, not for emphasizing the electrical discharge itself.

example.english: A flash of lightning lit up the dark night at once.
example.traditional: 電光一閃，黑夜即刻亮咗。
example.jyutping: din6 gwong1 jat1 sim2 hak1 je6 zik1 hak1 loeng6 zo2
